''See also: [[The Void (Cradle) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Void is a vast, chaotic expanse of nothingness and nonexistence that exists outside [[Way|the Way]]. It functions as an ocean of emptiness where reality, gravity, and logic hold little influence. Rather than being purely dark, the Void is filled with spinning, colorful specks that represent the remnants of destroyed worlds and galaxies. This environment is inherently hostile to existence, acting as a force of subtraction that constantly attempts to unmake or consume anything within it. The Void is home to various entities, including [[Fiends]]—creatures warped by its influence—and void beasts that can tear through the strands of order. It is also a place where [[Way|the Way]] feels distant and the presence of chaos is overwhelming. A significant aspect of this realm is the [[Void Icon]], an entity or power associated with [[hunger]], emptiness, and annihilation. The [[Icon]] is linked to the [[Void Sage]], a title held by [[Lindon]], who possesses a deep connection to this power and its fundamental property of consuming or removing [[aspects]] of reality. Through the [[Void Icon]], individuals can manifest [[void keys]]—spatial openings used for storage or travel—and access void matter, which serves as a potent tool of [[destruction]]. The Void is also characterized by its relationship to the concept of [[pure madra]], specifically the principle of [[Emptiness]], which can dilute other forms of energy by replacing them with nothingness.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The Void exists as a source of crackling darkness that distorts [[Way|the Way]] and serves as a realm where words can spread and echo. Situated beyond Fathom, which lies between [[Way|the Way]] and this dark expanse, the Void was breached when The [[Mad King|the Mad King]] tore open a hole to its depths. Following this intrusion, the Void quivers in fear of The [[Mad King|the Mad King]].}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Void is a dark space that can be accessed through portals or via a tear in the world. When such a [[portal]] has existed, twisted force can explode out of the Void from its location. This realm is associated with a distinct coldness and serves as a place where bodies are strewn. Furthermore, the Void is a concept linked to insights that result in the summoning of [[Fiends]], containing nameless creatures that even [[Red Faith]] would prefer to toss his soul to rather than face.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Existing beyond the parting of space, the Void is a realm where pieces of dead worlds float within spheres of light. This expanse exerts an influence that can be found even within a [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] through its specific Authority{{!}}authority. The Void actively seeks to unmake and break down any existing beings it encounters, pressing in close during this particular iteration. Ultimately, the nature of this place is such that one might find cause to be thankful for it when arriving in a United Realm.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Void is a place beyond the parting of space.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c1">''Waybound'', chapter 1</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] contained [[Void authority]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c9">''Waybound'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Void contains pieces of dead worlds floating in balls of light.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18">''Waybound'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Void attempts to break down existing beings and unmake them.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Void is something one might thank for ending up in a United Realm.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36">''Waybound'', chapter 36</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Void presses in close in this iteration.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c38">''Waybound'', chapter 38</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Void exists as a hostile emptiness located outside of the cosmos. This influence possesses the ability to affect unstable Pioneer worlds, where sight is not [[Jek'nan]]'s sharpest sense. Within this realm, raw matter is available for use. Furthermore, the madness of the Void is characterized by a grin belonging to the [[Wolf]] rather than the order of [[Way|the Way]].}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Sight is not [[Jek'nan]]'s sharpest sense in the Void.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|There was raw matter available in the Void.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
